headline: Computational tools for TCR clone expansion, TCR design, and pMHC-peptide design
label: T Cell Receptor Modeling
summary: Generative TCR and peptide design and post-vaccination clone detection are now formalized as computational pipelines with explicit benchmarking.
synthesis: The items share a focus on T cell receptor (TCR) recognition of antigen, approached computationally. CEI is a statistical framework that tests for significant abundance increases of TCR clones in peripheral blood before and after SARS-CoV-2 vaccination, treating the repertoire as a host-side readout. TCRAD and the TCR-pMHC benchmark address generative design. TCRAD is a deep learning pipeline for de novo design of antigen-conditioned CDR3beta sequences, incorporating filtration and structure prediction modules. The benchmark introduces a multi-stage pipeline and first benchmark for generative peptide design within TCR-pMHC complexes, assessing backbone generation and sequence design. What is new is the coupling of generative or statistical models to specific receptor and peptide sequence outputs, paired with explicit evaluation stages. The dominant thread is predictive and generative modeling of TCR-antigen recognition.
